purpose: Scientific argument and communication review for the Galaxy Bar article and writing skill
limits: The author-search discovery set is not a certified complete journal bibliography. It includes proceedings, white papers and other coauthored records.
Broad screening reads titles and selected abstract passages. Only the named focused records received body/caption review in this pass.
The earlier 77-paper review is retained separately; its reading depth is not silently promoted.
Coauthorship does not identify who wrote a passage. These are our interpretations of published choices, not private intentions or endorsement.
No third-party full text or figure images are redistributed. Numerical evidence was not changed or rerun.
